{{Quote|My partner Zinny and I train and supply bounty hunters. Got a little area to test out new gear, the whole bit.|Xenteel|<ref name="Tools" />}}
'''Xenteel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Zinny]]. The pair worked out of an industrial town named [[Jiguuna]] where provided training and supplies for other bounty hunters and had a stall set up in the town's market area. Xenteel directed a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who was hoping to take part in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] to Zinny for training during their time on Hutta.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm telling you, Zinny will get you set up right as rain.|Xenteel|<ref name="Tools" />}}
Xenteel was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], he had taken up a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and had become talented enough at the job to teach others in the art of bounty hunting. He teamed up with a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] woman named [[Zinny]] and the pair began a business of training and supplying other bounty hunters, using their own experience. Xenteel and her partner set up a stall for their business on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="Tools" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CodexHutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> The stall was in the market area of an industrial town named [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="Tools" /> which was controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref>
[[File:Zinny_stall.png|thumb|left|Zinny at her stall in Jiguuna.|250px]]

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Xenteel recognized a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] he saw whilst in the [[Poison Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in Jiguuna as the protégé of a veteran bounty hunter named [[Braden]]. He called over the individual and explained his and Zinny's business before directing them to Zinny to learn some new tricks. The hunter left the cantina and visited Zinny to improve their skills.<ref name="Tools" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Xenteel was considered an experienced bounty hunter during the time of the Cold War and knew enough about tricks, weapons, and maneuvers to be able to teach others members of the profession. He thought highly of his partner and would direct others to learn from her. Xenteel had dark skin and [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Tools" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xenteel first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game Xenteel is located on Nal Hutta which is the starting planet for players of the bounty hunter and [[Imperial Agent]] class. He is involved in the quest "Tools of the Trade" in which he directs bounty hunters to Zinny to learn their first class skills. Female players have the option to flirt with him. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].
